title: Xiangqi, Free Play, a composed scene with Black to move
why: The composed shape of the start policy: a document whose start_fen is not its game's frozen one. The position is a legal Xiangqi setup and Black has the move, so index 0 of moves is Black's ply and the fullmove number advances on it. A reader that checked start_fen against the frozen constant, or that paired plies by their parity, passes every other golden here and fails this one.
